detail: One run is deliberately not reproduced here. The operator typed while the REPL command was still being transmitted, so the keystrokes interleaved into the command line and it died with SyntaxError. That run produced no probe records, but it is what revealed that CircuitPython's built-in USB host driver was routing the keyboard to the serial console. Its raw content is the operator's arbitrary keystrokes and carries no measurement value.
